criteria.requirement: Implement xlsxwriter.atomic.atomic_workbook(destination,options=None) yielding a real Workbook writing to a same-directory temporary file. Only after body success and successful close/fsync replace the destination atomically; retain existing regular file permissions. Body/close/replace failures must preserve old destination and clean temporary files without masking original errors. Reject symlink/nonfile destinations, support new files and ordinary Workbook options without mutating caller mappings. This is a single local file operation, not a multi-file or hostile-race transaction.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
